note: USD per million tokens, owner-maintained. A null entry means the price is unknown and API-billed sessions on that model refuse to start. Keys are the routing entry's `model` value, which for Azure is the deployment name. Values are the Azure retail meters for westus3 GlobalStandard read on 2026-09-18 (prices.azure.com): gpt-6-astra and the Grok/DeepSeek lines all have a live meter now. gpt-6-astra doubles to 20/75 above its long-context threshold and that tier is not modelled here, so Astra sessions that run long under-count; the taskbudget clamp is the backstop.
